about: Replicated request from the server to play a sound on a character's client; routed by ecl::ServerSoundSystem::RouteCharacterServerRequests (macOS). Born live in many dialogues, scripted events (explosions, collapses), idle and item use.

evidence.says: Serializer bg3.exe+0x995AE0 member 1: 16 bytes at +0. macOS RouteCharacterServerRequests looks the two qwords at +0/+8 up in a HashMap<Guid, EntityHandle> (uuid -> handle) to find the character.
Serializer member 2: ecs::sync::Serialize(FixedString*) at +0x10; RouteCharacterServerRequests passes it to character::SoundSystem::PlaySound / PlayerManager::PlaySoundForLocalPlayer.

EoCServer.dll+0x845C60 (lambda over esv::sound::PlayServerSoundRequestOneFrameComponent, variant tag 0x1C = PlayServerSoundNotificationRequest) copies the request whole (Entity, Event, u32 +0xC, bytes +0x10/+0x11); dispatcher helper bg3.exe+0x2DEE710 stores request +0xC here, and on the same value chooses whose Guid goes to +0: 0 -> the character's, 1 -> the item's (esv::Item::GetUUID), 2/3 -> empty. Request +0xC is the one-frame's SoundObjectType (PlayHUDRequest writes 2).

bg3.exe+0x2DEE710 stores byte +0x10 of the PlayServerSoundNotificationRequest here, which EoCServer.dll+0x845C60 copied from esv::sound::PlayServerSoundRequestOneFrameComponent +0x10 - the byte esv::ServerSoundSystem::Request*SoundFromResource (EoCServer.dll+0x4CAA70 / +0x4CA860) set to 1 and RequestPlaySound / RequestPlayHUDSound set to 0. Client side: when set, RouteCharacterServerRequests resolves the sound through the current sound bank (type 9).

Serializer member 5: 1 byte at +0x19; macOS default strb wzr at +0x19; when set, RouteCharacterServerRequests calls PlayerManager::PlaySoundForLocalPlayer / PlayExternalSoundForLocalPlayer instead of the character sound system.
tail padding to 32; live garbage (sometimes pointer-shaped)
